Definition: an Asrielite (collectively) or descendant of Asriel
BiblicalUsage: The Asrielites were the family descended from Asriel, counted among the sons of Gilead in the wilderness census. The name marks a clan, not a single man.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God counted the clans as carefully as the men, and no family was lost in the crowd.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
